cards.name: Edward
cards.aside: (You're the Dungeon Master, so nobody at this table is going to make you show the die.)
lines: This is the test card, so you're both the sender and the recipient (Edward, you're writing yourself a holiday card in November, which in an escape room would be the clue that the door was unlocked the whole time, and in real life is just a little sad).

In April we hiked 2 weeks to Everest Base Camp and up Kala Patthar to 18,571 feet (the blog post covers the part where Dawn sat down on a rock 400 feet from the top and then finished anyway). The escape room count passed 300 a while ago, and the Eberron campaign for Mycroft and Eliot survived another year of my calendar.
Here's hoping 2027 brings you spreadsheets with Freeze Panes turned on and a sci-fi show that actually gets its second season (Firefly got cancelled in 2002, which makes it 24 years and counting).
